name: City Center
summary: City Center is an urban retail property located on Geary Boulevard in San Francisco, serving the affluent neighborhoods of Pacific Heights, Presidio Heights, and Laurel Heights. The center offers flexible retail spaces and benefits from its proximity to Golden Gate Park, major medical centers, and the University of San Francisco.
demographics: City Center attracts an affluent, educated demographic from the surrounding neighborhoods of Pacific Heights, Presidio Heights, Laurel Heights, and the Richmond District, which are among San Francisco's most desirable residential areas. The trade area is characterized by high household incomes, professional occupations, and a mix of young professionals and established families who value convenience and quality. Shoppers in this area tend to prioritize local, specialty retailers and services that cater to their sophisticated tastes and busy urban lifestyles, with strong demand for everyday essentials, dining, and health-related services given the proximity to major medical centers.
description: City Center is a prominent urban retail destination strategically positioned on Geary Boulevard, one of San Francisco's busiest and most trafficked commercial corridors. This shopping center serves as a vital retail hub for some of the city's most affluent and desirable neighborhoods, including Pacific Heights, Presidio Heights, Laurel Heights, and the Richmond District, offering convenient access to everyday shopping and services. The property benefits from its exceptional location near major San Francisco landmarks and institutions, including Golden Gate Park, The Park Presidio, University of San Francisco, Kaiser Permanente Hospital, and UCSF Medical Center, ensuring consistent foot traffic from both residents and visitors. With available retail spaces ranging from 1,333 to 9,969 square feet, City Center provides flexible leasing opportunities for a diverse mix of tenants looking to establish or expand their presence in this dense, high-income trade area. The center's competitive advantage lies in its scale, retail offerings, and unparalleled ease of access within San Francisco, making it a premier choice for retailers seeking to tap into the city's vibrant 24/7 cultural scene and affluent consumer base.
